SELECT v.ID, v.Name, v.Age
FROM visitor v
JOIN (
    SELECT visitor_ID
    FROM visit
    GROUP BY visitor_ID
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
) t ON v.ID = t.visitor_ID;
